summary: Bug-fix verification for the 4 export/download buttons on /results. Used Playwright's expect_download to capture the real download event (not just click handler execution). ALL 4 buttons produce a downloaded file with the correct slug-based filename, non-empty content, correct sections, correct KPI-matching totals, correct horizon-aware column labels for both 12-month and 24-month projections, correct toasts, and NO JS console errors. Regression: inline sales-units cell edit correctly recalculates sales-grand-total (and gross-margin-total/header-margin remain consistent).

export-csv-btn.toast: Sales + cost assumptions downloaded in one CSV

verification_details.number_match: UI KPI revenue = $58,800  ==  CSV TOTAL REVENUE last col = 58800.00 (match)
verification_details.inline_edit_regression: Edited sales-units-<item>-0 from 400 -> 999. sales-grand-total updated $58,800 -> $64,191. gross-margin-total & header-margin recomputed (stayed at 66.5% because price=9 and cost=3 keeps margin constant; per-month margin cell showed 66.6% for the edited month confirming recalc).

spec_note: Task description requested 'Annual revenue ($)' / '24-month revenue ($)' with lowercase 'r'. Implementation uses capitalized 'Annual Revenue ($)' / '24-month Revenue ($)' (and 'Annual Direct Cost ($)' / '24-month Direct Cost ($)' for cost). Purely a cosmetic capitalization difference — functional requirement (horizon-aware label) is satisfied.
critical_code_review_comments: downloadBlob helper in /app/frontend/src/lib/model.js correctly appends <a> to document.body, .click()s it, then removes+revokeObjectURL after 2s — this is the correct pattern for sandboxed iframes and Firefox. Fix is sound.
Combined CSV write is done via a single Blob (one download event) — avoids the browser's rapid-double-download blocking that was hitting the previous implementation. Good.
CSV blobs include a UTF-8 BOM (\uFEFF) for Excel compatibility. Good.
Minor: horizon label capitalization ('Annual Revenue' vs 'Annual revenue' in spec). Not a bug, just note.
seed_data_creation: None — localStorage-only wizard state (business 'Test Co', bakery, 2 items, prices 9/65, volumes flat 400/20, costs 3/22).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 export buttons on /results verified working with real Playwright download events. Filenames slug from businessName ('test-co-...'). XLSX has 3 sheets. Combined CSV is a single file with sales section then cost section. Horizon label switches correctly between 'Annual' (months=12) and '24-month' (months=24). Note: profile-months is a <select> element (use select_option, not fill). Note: to avoid state bleed between test runs, evaluate localStorage.clear() before reloading. sales-units cells have testid pattern `sales-units-{itemId}-{monthIdx}` (not `sales-units-cell-...`).
rca of the issue: Previous bug (no files downloaded in user's real browser) had two root causes both fixed in this build: (1) detached <a> element was ignored by the sandboxed preview iframe and some browsers; the shared downloadBlob() now appends the anchor to document.body before .click() and cleans up afterward. (2) The old 'Both CSVs' button fired two downloads 400ms apart which browsers block-second — replaced with a single combined-CSV file. Verification: expect_download() successfully captured all 4 downloads.
